response.sql:
WITH project_groups AS (
  SELECT
    s.arcref AS project_ref,
    p.fundflux AS funding_source,
    SUM(s.gbsize) / NULLIF(SUM(s.spanmin), 0) AS rate
  FROM scans AS s
  JOIN projects AS p
    ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM project_groups
)
SELECT
  g.project_ref,
  g.funding_source,
  g.rate,
  g.rate - b.avg_rate AS excess
FROM project_groups AS g
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE g.rate > b.avg_rate
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Groups with zero or NULL total duration have an undefined rate and are excluded from the benchmark and results; NULL file sizes are ignored by SUM, per SQL aggregate behavior.
